_comment: Rayyan dedup failures detected by hash-identical PDFs at full-text screening. Each entry: 'excluded' key is the secondary record (conference or book-chapter version), 'primary' key is the kept record (journal version, more citable). Both records refer to the same underlying work; the reviewer keeps the primary in PRISMA flow and reports the duplicates removed at full-text. See data_quality_report.md §3 for evidence.
